#!/bin/bash
# Setup script to configure environment from .env.test

# Source the .env.test file to load environment variables
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    # Use grep with basic pattern and handle potential encoding issues
    API_LINE=$(grep -F "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" .env.test || grep -a "ANTHROPIC" .env.test)
    if [ -n "$API_LINE" ]; then
        # Extract value after the equals sign, removing any carriage returns
        API_VALUE=$(echo "$API_LINE" | sed 's/.*=//' | tr -d '\r')
        export ADMIN_TOKEN="$API_VALUE"
        echo "Successfully set ADMIN_TOKEN from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
    else
        echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not found in .env.test file"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo ".env.test file not found! Please ensure it exists."
    exit 1
fi
